# Jokers

<!-- Generated from engine/src/joker.rs by `make jokers-doc`: do not edit by hand. -->

Jokers are bought in the shop between blinds (5 slots at most) and sell for
half their price. While a hand is scored, card jokers trigger for each scoring
card right after its chips; hand jokers then trigger once, left to right.

| Id | Name | Price | Sells for | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `baobab` | Baobab | $4 | $2 | +30 chips |
| `calabash` | Calabash | $4 | $2 | +5 mult |
| `market` | Market | $5 | $2 | +2 mult for each scoring diamond |
| `wrapper` | Wrapper | $5 | $2 | +15 chips for each scoring heart |
| `griot` | Griot | $5 | $2 | +20 chips for each scoring face card |
| `zemidjan` | Zemidjan | $5 | $2 | +12 mult if the hand is a straight |
| `tontine` | Tontine | $5 | $2 | +$1 per discard left at the end of the blind |
| `djembe` | Djembe | $6 | $3 | +2 mult for each scoring card |
| `harmattan` | Harmattan | $7 | $3 | ×2 mult if the played hand has 3 cards or fewer |
| `mask` | Mask | $8 | $4 | ×3 mult if the hand is a three of a kind |
